_comment: Three stages: the agent's terminal, the merchant screen, the payer's phone. Every line narrates the exact thing on screen at that moment. ~165 words ≈ 58s at Louis's pace.

beats.text: An AI agent just spent your money — did you want it to? The shop can't tell. No dispute code exists for "my agent did it", so merchants simply refuse AI customers.
lines: An AI agent just spent your money. Did you actually want it to?
The shop can't tell — and no dispute code exists for "my agent did it."
So merchants simply refuse AI customers.

beats.cue: terminal — real agent output, APPROVE highlighted
beats.text: So we built the fix. Watch a real purchase: the agent's AI brain approves the deal, and pays. Real Singapore dollars, live on Avalanche.
lines: So we built the fix. Watch a real purchase:
the agent's AI brain approves the deal — and pays.
Real Singapore dollars, live on Avalanche.

beats.text: The payment lands with a built-in pause: the shop holds it, signed and locked, but can't collect for ninety seconds. Nobody's waiting — only the money is.
lines: The payment lands with a built-in pause.
The shop holds it — signed and locked — but can't collect for 90 seconds.
Nobody is waiting. Only the money is.

beats.text: Let the shop try early. The money itself refuses. That answer came from the token contract, not from any server of ours.
lines: Let the shop try early —
the money itself refuses.
That's the token contract talking. Not our server.

beats.text: And you keep the last word. Changed your mind? One tap. That cancellation just went on-chain, permanently.
lines: And you keep the last word.
Changed your mind? One tap.
That cancellation just went on-chain. Permanently.

beats.text: Your balance never moved. Nothing to refund, because nothing ever left.
lines: Your balance never moved.
Nothing to refund — because nothing ever left.

beats.cue: events — Canceled and Used side by side
beats.text: Say nothing, and Amazon's scheduler settles it on time — final, no chargebacks. There's the earlier order, settled on its own.
lines: Say nothing — Amazon's scheduler settles it on time. Final. No chargebacks.
There's the earlier order, settled on its own.

beats.text: Everyone else makes agents pay. GRACE makes merchants able to accept. Nobody ever held your money. Nobody had to.
lines: Everyone else makes agents pay.
GRACE makes merchants able to accept.
Nobody ever held your money. Nobody had to.
